name: io.github.forageseed/annolens
title: AnnoLens
description: Evidence-driven gene-model curation: review, repair, split and add gene models from transcripts, proteins and reads.

environmentVariables.name: ANNOLENS_MANIFEST
environmentVariables.description: Path of the project manifest annolens.toml on the machine that holds the data

environmentVariables.name: ANNOLENS_SSH
environmentVariables.description: ssh host of the data machine (leave empty when the data are local)

environmentVariables.name: ANNOLENS_REMOTE_CMD
environmentVariables.description: Command that runs the annolens CLI on the data machine (default: annolens)
